newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold ends steady on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold ends steady on profit-taking.

text.p: Profit-taking on the back of improved supplies hurt gold prices on Wednesday, dealers said.

Gold opened the day higher on the back of fresh physical buying ahead of wedding season. Gold was down by 10 rupees per 10 gms on Tuesday. Gold biscuit (116.50 gms) settled 50 rupees lower at 60,350 rupees per piece.
They had fallen by 150 rupees on Tuesday. Some traders were expecting fresh recovery ahead of wedding season.
Silver opened on a subdued note and remained quiet at that level during the day, amid limited activity. Silver was down by Rs 25 per kg on Tuesday.
